detects.chromatic_class: the PBD class: lit member set per index, tint energies/ratio, tir fractions (entry measure x Fresnel through one kernel on a plate family sample)
detects.chromatic_diagnose: the colour verdict (kind/color/visible), every feature's criterion quantities, the threshold snapshot (N_RED/N_BLUE/EDGE_MIN_SHIFT_RAD/EDGE_SPREAD_PER_SHIFT/TINT_RATIO_MIN)
detects.dp_field_kinks: TIR-onset curve structure (step/margin/method, arc count, closed, ends) and D envelope per index; the constant circles pin their closed-form value (3-1-6, C06)
detects.dp_field_sample: D_P / gradient / U_P gate margins / A_P / T_P / w at fixed u: chain or index drift, gate-set change, corridor (entry measure) regression, weight-kernel mismatch
detects.dp_field_topology: partition bounds and counts, critical values, corner margin signatures, degenerate-fold fields, domain topology counts: partition escapes, corner Newton, slab-crease gates, chart audit
detects.focusing_classify: the kind-1 onset table and its labels (mechanism, profile, jacobian_focusing, multiplicity), gradient_norm_range, family_pinned
detects.wavelength_critical_table: onset displacement across n(lambda): the wavelength-critical preset (task 42.4)

cell.rationale: the 120 deg parhelion tint on the rhombic plate (h/a = 1, sun 9 deg): tint blue, ratio 1.492, four of the 24 members lit (the printed digits of chromatic-module-c.md "Evidence")

family.sampler: pose_density.sample_plate_poses: uniform spin, half-normal tilt, uniform tilt direction, numpy.random.default_rng(seed)

thresholds.authority: lumice_integral.chromatic; this block is a recorded snapshot, not a second implementation

direction_dispersion.basis: absolute, rad: zero for a slab-like class (measured < 1e-12 in LI); a dispersive class reports its own note and none is exported

members.basis: exact: the PBD orbit (chromatic.class_members) and, per index, the lit member list (a sampled verdict on the family sample; chromatic's own resolution statement, ChromaticVerdict docstring)

tint_energies.basis: relative: statistical: the family sample is LI's numpy PCG64 stream (sample_plate_poses, seed 3, 1e5 poses); a backend estimates the same family mean from its own sample.  LI's split-half sigma of the ratio at 1e5 poses is <= 3e-3 on the three class cells, so 5e-2 is > 15 sigma; energies carry the same relative room

tint_ratio.basis: absolute: statistical: the family sample is LI's numpy PCG64 stream (sample_plate_poses, seed 3, 1e5 poses); a backend estimates the same family mean from its own sample.  LI's split-half sigma of the ratio at 1e5 poses is <= 3e-3 on the three class cells, so 5e-2 is > 15 sigma; energies carry the same relative room

tir_fractions.basis: absolute: an A T-weighted fraction of the same sampled reflections
